{"text":"ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle already covers streaming, so this would duplicate it.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A larger display interests me, but I would keep using my recently acquired Show 5 for now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a fourth-generation Dot and have no clear need for an older additional speaker.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would try controlling a lamp through my existing Echo devices; it adds a useful function to my setup.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently bought a second-generation Show 5 and its stand, so this older version adds little.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My existing 4K Max makes another HD streaming stick unnecessary right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire 7 tablet, 7" display, 16 GB, (2019 release), Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in useful accessories for my current devices than adding a tablet without a specific purpose.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Auto (1st gen) - Hands-free Alexa in your car with your phone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I use Alexa at home, but I do not currently have a clear need to add it to my car.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: 64GB EVO Select Memory Card and Sabrent SuperSpeed 2-Slot USB 3.0 Flash Memory Card Reader; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Removable storage fits my interests, but my existing multiport card reader makes this bundle less compelling today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: SanDisk 32GB 2-Pack Ultra MicroSDHC UHS-I Memory Card (2x32GB) - SDSQUAR-032G-GN6MT; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would pick these as spare removable storage to use with my existing card reader, after checking device compatibility."}
